findings.detail: The isolated percent-of-net-assets format violation localizes to the SOI total-investments row, which is an aggregate schedule total rather than a position.

rationale: The source shows net assets of 1,759,611 and total investments at fair value of 2,631,138, which reconciles to the schedule total of 149.5% of net assets. A targeted source search found exactly one 149.5% row: table 38 row 36, labeled 'Total Investments, June 30, 2024', not an individual portfolio company position. Because the rule fired once across the percent-of-net-assets population and the only matching outlier is an aggregate total line, the defect is a localized subtotal/total leak rather than a valid position value.
